readerCopy.body: Closeness becomes easier when the subjects that matter most no longer have to be treated as the subjects most likely to ruin the bond. When Venus trines Pluto, connection and depth reinforce each other, allowing more honesty around money, loyalty, fear, intimacy, ownership, and power without turning every difficult subject into a crisis. Intensity does not have to be manufactured. The relationship can hold more truth simply because less energy is spent protecting it from the conversations already shaping it.
